choices.why: It is the tallest and widest of the options, in dark wood that matches the floor, and it holds many books against the left wall.
The caramel leather lounge armchair is comfortable, warm and sized for a corner by the window, and it stands out against the dark wood.
The slim aluminium reading lamp has an adjustable head that lights the book and takes little space beside the armchair.
The round walnut-and-gold nesting tables are small and warm, and the top is a good size for a coffee cup beside the armchair.
The light beige round shaggy rug is cozy and matches the request for a light round rug, and it contrasts with the dark floor.
The beige boucle throw is a natural, cozy textile that looks good over the leather armchair.
The beige linen curtains add a natural warmth and soften the large corner window without clashing with the concrete ceiling.

answer.why: Dark wood, caramel leather and beige natural textiles make a warm palette that contrasts with the white walls and concrete ceiling. The reading corner by the window is cozy, with the tall bookcase against the left wall.
